prompt: My wife left me,  I have never been single since I was living with my parents.   What do I do now?  Where can I turn too? (I am not mentally ill in any way)
response: It's tough to be on your own for the first time, but you can handle this. Start by reaching out to friends and family for support. Consider seeing a therapist to help you navigate this transition, even if you're not mentally ill. They can provide strategies for adjusting to single life and coping with the changes. You can also join support groups for people in similar situations. Remember, it's okay to ask for help during this time.
